purpose: Keep strategy R&D from treating the current executable price-action families as the full strategy universe.

status_legend.implemented_single_asset_replay: Runnable replay family exists, but still needs evidence gates before shadow.
status_legend.implemented_panel_research: Runnable panel research exists, but does not directly produce promotable strategy policy.
status_legend.implemented_panel_scorer: Runnable scorer or gate exists; it can filter research universe but is not a trading edge.
status_legend.design_backlog: Mechanism is worth designing, but replay or portfolio semantics are missing.
status_legend.data_backlog: Mechanism is worth researching, but point-in-time data or data contract is missing.
status_legend.out_of_scope_now: Valid market strategy class, but outside the current 4H+ swing product boundary.

families.promotion_boundary: Can only become strategy evidence after replay, OOS, costs, negative controls, locked holdout, and shadow.
known_lessons: BTC 4H variants have repeatedly failed OOS or regime robustness; do not continue by adding filters only.
next_actions: Only revisit with a distinct thesis certificate or different data surface.

families.promotion_boundary: Can only become strategy evidence after replay and external validation; panel failures are not strategy assets.

next_actions: Do not spend new trial budget on the same SBR hypothesis without a new mechanism.

next_actions: Prefer panel momentum with marketability gate over more BTC-only TSM filters.

planner_rules: If a family has status data_backlog, open data governance work before consuming strategy trial budget.
If a family has status design_backlog, create hypothesis certificate and replay semantics before trials.
If a family has status implemented_panel_scorer, use it only to filter or rank the research universe.
If a family has status implemented_panel_research, do not land a strategy until portfolio construction contract exists.
If recent learning memory rejected a mechanism, do not schedule the same mechanism with extra filters as a new hypothesis.
